meta.name: social-media-manager
meta.description: Social Media Manager role skill. Orchestrates the full SMB social media workflow across three layers — Foundation (brand setup + calendar), Content Creation (captions, platform-specialist posts, visuals), and Distribution (scheduling via Blotato + performance review). Coordinates all 9 component skills as a sequential, human-reviewed pipeline. Run this skill instead of invoking component skills individually.
